# Reset-ZbxUserTotp

## SYNOPSIS

Resets users' one-time password secrets.

## SYNTAX

```
Reset-ZbxUserTotp [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUser>[]> [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Reset-ZbxUserTotp cmdlet deletes the time-based one-time password secret of the users given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped users) with user.resettotp, so each enrolls a new authenticator at the next login, for a lost or replaced phone. Every user the pipeline brings is reset in one call. The command writes the users only with -PassThru, and -WhatIf shows what it would reset.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Reset a user's authenticator

```powershell
Reset-ZbxUserTotp -InputObject 'jdoe'
```

-InputObject (position 0) takes a user's name, id or object.

### Example 2: Preview resetting every user of a group

```powershell
Get-ZbxUser -UserGroup 'Operators' | Reset-ZbxUserTotp -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf names each user the command would reset, and resets nothing.
